description: This file defines a class LogWrapper that implements the LogNode interface to wrap Android's native Log utility, enabling flexible logging with chaining capability.

classes.name: LogWrapper
classes.description: A helper class that wraps Android's Log utility to facilitate logging with support for chaining log nodes.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode to which log data will be forwarded.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Logs messages to Android's Log system, handling null message and Throwable, and forwards log entries to the next node if present.
